title: 第17章炼化祖龙残魂，剑斗罗找上门来-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    唐昊也被叶寒的反应惊了一跳，将隐藏在体内的杀气释放出去，将周围变成一片血红色的世界。

    在这个世界中，弥漫着实质化的杀气。

    在唐昊的操控下，这些杀气凝聚成一根根猩红色的锁链，绑在叶寒的身上。

    “吞噬！”

    叶寒感知到杀气，面露喜色，当即运转系统奖励的修罗杀伐诀。

    刹那间，猩红色的锁链以肉眼可见的速度消失，转化成杀气，逐渐钻入叶寒的体内。

    唐昊感知到杀气正在以极快的速度流失，脸色骤然一变。

    他想将杀神领域收回来，却发现有一股强大的力量，在拉扯领域收回。

    要知道，杀神领域是他在杀戮之都获得的领域，威力极强，比普通领域还要霸道、强悍。

    自从他得到杀神领域以来，还是第一次遇见这种情况。

    眼见着他多年来聚集的杀气就要被叶寒吞噬，唐昊不得不唤出昊天锤武魂，借助昊天锤武魂的霸道，将叶寒的吞噬强行打断，这才把杀神领域收回来。

    由于叶寒是第一次修炼修罗杀伐决，刚才吞噬的杀气又太多了，在唐昊强行打断的那一刻，遭受到了反噬，彻底晕死了过去。

    赵无极和弗兰德见到这一幕，脸色一沉，纵身而跃，护在他的身前。

    赵无极更是将叶寒抱了起来，唤出大力金刚熊武魂，做好了誓死一搏的准备。

    弗兰德则是警惕地望向唐昊，说道：“昊天冕下，你刚才说了不动手，您可不能说话不算数。”

    “男人大丈夫说话算话，我什么时候打算动手了。”

    “再敢诋毁本座的信誉，小心老子揍你们。”

    唐昊收起昊天锤，抡起砂锅大的拳头，向赵无极和弗兰德威胁。

    弗兰德见他没有动手的意图，抹了把额头上的冷汗，讨好道：“昊天冕下消消气，我们也是相信你的。”

    这要是打起来，他们肯定不是对手。

    “屁话！”

    “若是你们相信，刚才就不是这个反应。”

    “不过，你们这种护短的作风，倒是挺不错的。”

    “小三留在史莱克学院，我也算是放心了。”

    “在接下来的几年里，小三就拜托你们照顾了。”

    “至于这小子，倒是个怪胎，就让他慢慢成为小三的磨脚石吧。”

    唐昊啐了一口，向弗兰德和赵无极交代了几句，便纵身离开。

    在离开之前，他还特意瞥了小舞一眼，似乎是在警告。

    小舞看到唐昊离开时的眼神，脸色微微一变。

    她能看得出来，唐昊的眼神中闪过一丝威胁。

    “呼，终于把这个瘟神送走了。”

    弗兰德见唐昊已经失去了身影，长吐了口气，转头望向昏迷过去的叶寒，眼神中满是兴奋。

    叶寒能在唐昊的魂力威压和杀神领域的压迫下坚持下来，已经远远超出了他的想象。

    他的体魄和意志力早就超越了所有同龄人，甚至连他和赵无极这种成名已久的强者，也远远不及。

    “是啊，终于走了。”

    “不过，我这顿打，也没有白挨。”

    “他好像是在指点我。”

    “院长，我有预感，我们史莱克学院恐怕用不了几年就能名扬斗罗大陆。”

    “叶寒和唐三就是我们的希望。”

    赵无极探查了一下叶寒的情况，见他没有受伤，也算是彻底松了口气。

    “是啊，我也有这个预感。”

    “或许，我们可以尝试参加明年的全大陆高级魂师学院精英大赛。”

    “但在此之前，我们还是要尽快把他们培养起来。”

    弗兰德连连点头，心中开始揣摩如何参加明年的魂师大赛。
    第(1/3)页

Tang Hao was also startled by Ye Han's reaction. He released the murderous aura hidden in his body, turning the surroundings into a blood-red world.

In this world, there is substantial murderous intent.

Under Tang Hao's control, these murderous auras condensed into scarlet chains and were tied to Ye Han's body.

"Swallow!"

Ye Han sensed the murderous intent, his face showed joy, and he immediately ran the Shura Killing Technique rewarded by the system.

In an instant, the scarlet chain disappeared at a speed visible to the naked eye, turned into murderous aura, and gradually penetrated into Ye Han's body.

Tang Hao felt that the murderous aura was draining away at an extremely fast speed, and his expression suddenly changed.

He wanted to take back the God of Death domain, but found a powerful force pulling the domain back.

You must know that the Killing God Domain is the domain he obtained in the Killing City. It is extremely powerful and more domineering and powerful than the ordinary domain.

This is the first time he has encountered this situation since he obtained the Killing God Realm.

Seeing that the murderous aura he had accumulated over the years was about to be swallowed up by Ye Han, Tang Hao had to summon the Clear Sky Hammer Spirit, and with the help of the Haotian Hammer Spirit's dominance, he forcibly interrupted Ye Han's devouring, and then took back the God of Death Domain.

Since it was the first time for Ye Han to practice the Shura Killing Technique, he had swallowed too much murderous intent. The moment Tang Hao forcibly interrupted, he suffered a backlash and completely fainted.

When Zhao Wuji and Flanders saw this scene, their expressions darkened and they jumped up to protect him.

Zhao Wuji even hugged Ye Han, summoned the powerful Vajra Bear martial spirit, and was ready for a fight to the death.

Flender looked at Tang Hao warily and said, "Your Majesty Haotian, you just said you wouldn't do anything. You can't just keep your word."

"A man keeps his word, when will I take action?"

"If you dare to slander my credibility again, I will beat you up."

Tang Hao put away the Clear Sky Hammer, raised his fist as big as a casserole, and threatened Zhao Wuji and Flender.

Seeing that he had no intention of taking action, Flanders wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said flatteringly: "Haotian, please calm down, we also believe in you."

“If this were to come to a fight, they would definitely not be opponents.

"Bullshit!"

"If you believe it, that's not the reaction just now."

"However, your style of protecting shortcomings is quite good."

"I feel relieved that my mistress is staying at Shrek Academy."

"In the next few years, I will ask you to take care of my mistress."

"As for this kid, he's quite a freak. Let him slowly become the mistress's grinding stone."

Tang Hao spat, said a few words to Flanders and Zhao Wuji, and then left.

Before leaving, he glanced at Xiao Wu, as if to warn her.

Xiao Wu’s face changed slightly when she saw Tang Hao’s eyes when he left.

She could see that there was a hint of threat in Tang Hao's eyes.

"Phew, we finally sent this plague god away."

Seeing that Tang Hao had disappeared, Flanders let out a long breath and turned to look at the unconscious Ye Han, his eyes full of excitement.

Ye Han's ability to persist under the pressure of Tang Hao's soul power and the oppression of the God of Death realm was far beyond his imagination.

His physique and willpower have long surpassed those of all his peers, and even those who have been famous for a long time like him and Zhao Wuji are far behind.

"Yes, I finally left."

"However, the beating I received was not in vain."

"He seemed to be giving me directions."

"Dean, I have a hunch that our Shrek Academy may become famous in Douluo Continent within a few years."

"Ye Han and Tang San are our hope."

Zhao Wuji checked Ye Han's condition and was completely relieved to see that he was not injured.

"Yes, I have this hunch too."

"Perhaps, we can try to participate in next year's Continental Advanced Soul Master Academy Elite Competition."

“But before that, we still have to train them as soon as possible.”

Flender nodded repeatedly and began to think about how to participate in next year's Soul Master Competition.
